summary: Preschool baking game to develop logic, motor skills and coordination for kids
description:
CAKES ON AN OBSTACLE COURSE? THAT’S A TRICKYBALL!
In this dexterity-based game, your child guides a pastry through a magical circuit filled with buttons, trampolines, cranes, and elevators.
Each level is a mini challenge, specially designed for children aged 3 to 6.
No stress, no timer-just playful learning at their own pace!

A GAME BY PANGO
With over 20 educational apps and 15 million downloads worldwide, Pango is a trusted name for parents looking for smart, caring games.
TrickyBall - Bakery follows this same philosophy: an interactive and engaging game designed to develop coordination, logic, and fine motor skills.
It’s accessible from age 3 and encourages independent discovery and joyful experimentation.

15 DELICIOUS CHALLENGES TO MASTER!
With a variety of frostings, toppings, sprinkles, fruits… and even sausages, every pastry becomes a funny and tasty adventure!
Your child will tap, trigger, roll, and bounce cakes through creative and adorable obstacle-filled circuits.

SAFE AND DESIGNED FOR YOUNG CHILDREN:
• Progressive difficulty adapted to each child
• No ads
• No hidden purchases
• Parental controls in place

WHY PARENTS LOVE TRICKYBALL:
• Enhances coordination and precision
• Develops logic and problem-solving skills
• Encourages autonomy and creativity
• Helps channel focus in a playful way

TRY FOR FREE, THEN UNLOCK MORE LEVELS AT YOUR OWN PACE
TrickyBall - Bakery is free to download, with one introductory level included.
Additional levels can be unlocked via in-app purchases, individually or as a complete pack-your choice.
All purchases are protected by parental controls, and as always with Pango: no ads.

TRUST & SUPPORT
At Pango, we’ve been designing playful experiences for over 15 years that respect children’s pace, spark their curiosity, and support their growth.
No ads, no pressure-just the joy of learning through play, in a safe and caring environment.
Need help or have a question? Contact us at pango@studio-pango.com or check out our FAQ.
Learn more about our world: www.studio-pango.com
